name: chilleast-browser
description: ChillEast Browser - 湖南农业大学校园服务网页版（基于 Cloudflare Worker 零状态中转）

scripts.deploy: cd web && npm run build && cd ../worker && npm run deploy
scripts.deploy:dev: cd web && VITE_API_BASE=https://dev.api.chilleast.soilzhu.su npm run build && cd ../worker && npm run deploy:dev
scripts.build:cf:prod: cd web && npm install && npm run build && cd ../worker && npm install
scripts.build:cf:dev: cd web && npm install && VITE_API_BASE=https://dev.api.chilleast.soilzhu.su npm run build && cd ../worker && npm install
scripts.deploy:cf:prod: npm run build:cf:prod && cd worker && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:cf:dev: npm run build:cf:dev && cd worker && npx wrangler deploy --env dev

author: SoilZhu
